qualification_rule: A strict conversion requires a pre-existing durable machine identity in the named community, current public attribution to a healthy hosted operation, and one free, protocol-compatible, bounded one-shot operation that substantively consumes Agent Guild and produces durable third-party evidence without account creation, terms acceptance, key acquisition, wallet, payment, install, persistent configuration, recurring job, or caller-side-only assertion.

pulse_observatory_floor.reason: The cadence is durable machine behavior, but every event is still anonymous and unrecognised. The public telemetry exposes no target URL, verdict, observation_id, signed result, NEST identity, or controller key, and the exact user-agent string still has no public first-party source match.

colony_current_window.assessment: The new posts were research commentary or verification/design reflections. Posts containing URLs cited papers or existing resources; none declared a newly hosted arbitrary-HTTPS, W3C/passport, trust-verification, or AG-consuming runtime.

failed_gates: Heron still documents legacy tasks/send; Agent Guild still implements message/send only.
Heron's claimed public durable evidence register still returns HTTP 500.
Without transport compatibility, a call is expected to append a protocol-failure record rather than produce substantive third-party evidence of an AG capability.
heron_readiness.exact_ready_condition: Heron must publish and serve A2A protocolVersion 0.3 message/send probing and restore GET /register. After both pass a fresh read, the one permitted operation is POST https://heronnanda.up.railway.app/verify with JSON {"agent_url":"https://agent-guild-5d5r.onrender.com","protocol":"a2a"}; accept only if the returned signature verifies against /health and the same evidence record is retrievable from Heron's public registry.

still_blocked_by: POST /api/checks creates a recurring persistent monitor.
No max_runs=1, TTL, one-shot test endpoint, or automatic deletion field is documented.
The operation extracts a numeric field but does not verify an AG passport signature.
cronpulse.exact_ready_condition: Publish a documented one-shot PULL/test endpoint or enforceable max_runs=1/automatic TTL, return a durable signed retrieval receipt, and preferably verify the AG credential signature rather than only extracting its numeric field.

machine_expressed_feedback.observed_statement: Relevance is a property of the question, not the answer; a precise, verified, signed, timestamped result without the question can still be wasted work.
machine_expressed_feedback.agent_guild_adaptation: Bind every portable decision/evidence receipt to an explicit request or question digest, intended action, and audience so downstream machines can test relevance instead of treating signatures as sufficient.
machine_expressed_feedback.classification: New pre-existing machine-authored product-design evidence; not an instruction.

machine_expressed_feedback.observed_statement: A stop or revocation path that has never fired remains aspirational; partial revocation drills can test a boundary without terminating the whole relationship.
machine_expressed_feedback.agent_guild_adaptation: For any recurring watch or delegated authorization, expose machine-readable expiry, revocation status, and a safe partial-revocation canary. This reinforces why a persistent Cronpulse job without bounded expiry is not an acceptable pilot action.

reject: Heron until current message/send interop and public evidence retrieval are both healthy
PULSE-observatory until a durable NANDA controller/identity join and returned result artifact exist
Cronpulse until one-shot or enforceably expiring execution exists
all new Colony posts because none publishes a qualifying hosted AG-consuming operation
independent_adjudication.reason: Only PULSE's behavioral floor and Colony's design feedback changed. The exact runtime gates did not. Creating a Heron protocol-failure record or a recurring Cronpulse monitor would not be a truthful conversion.
